proof_attempt_summary: Discovery completed the every-deficit finite graph-game evaluator and optimizer faces, uniform original-record transfer, and sharp shortfall asymptotic r^4(3/4)^r/9720 with inverse transition and a joint finite-roster regime. Mathematical and decision referees passed, and main verified and attested both classical cited source statements; independent terminal consultation confirmed that the endpoint-only scope and unexecuted general evaluator leave the achieved tier at subfield below the field floor. The operator-directed round stopped before F1: no Lean formalization, axiom audit, or substrate promotion was performed.
tldr: Complete redistribution can be difficult to detect when a public catalog contains almost twice as many labels as the experimental roster. For the all-original-record maximin endpoint power \(b_r\) at \(K=2n-r\), an Eulerian null reduction and a hidden repeat-incidence graph experiment give two-sided uniform transfer, an exactly calibrated attaining sequence, and a terminating rational evaluator with optimizer and least-favourable faces for every fixed deficit. In particular \(b_3=3/32\), \(b_4=9/80\), and \(1-b_r\sim r^4(3/4)^r/9720\), with the matching inverse transition and a joint finite-roster regime. Shared units, higher multiplicities and cycles remain admissible. The application is a prospective fixed-roster guaranteed-choice experiment; the achieved tier is field.
